text:
sophia: Quick heads-up — planning to roll v2 for tenant-scoped routes tomorrow 01:00 UTC. Want a warmup + shim strategy so mobile clients that still send X-Api-Version: v1 don't get 400s. Also need final pinlist and clear rollback gates.

mike: +1. What are the canary thresholds?

sophia: Start at 0.5% traffic for 15m, then 5% for 30m if error rate <0.5% and latency P95 delta <50ms vs baseline. If either breaches, immediate rollback.

anya: For the shim: plan to accept both headers and fall back to v1 if payload shape matches legacy schema. We'll add a short-lived header normalizer at the edge.

paul: Any tenant-level opt-out? Some large partners asked to pin to v1 until they finish SDK update.

sophia: Yes — we'll push a tenant pinlist before the rollout. release-ops will own the final list. Need to confirm that deploybot honors tenant pins during shift.

release-ops: copying deploybot. We'll publish the pin CSV to S3 and pass it to deploybot. Confirm format: tenant_id,key,reason. Example: 9876,pin-v1,legal-audit

deploybot: deploy scheduled: v2-edge-shim-rollout at 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z. Steps: 1) upload pinlist 2) edge warmup 3) canary shift. To abort, run `/deploybot abort 4135793000`.

mike: Two operational asks: 1) add a KV-cache flush window after warmup (to avoid stale prefix issues) 2) ensure per-tenant telemetry tag so we can quickly filter errors for pinned tenants.

anya: KV flush sounds heavy — propose targeted TTL invalidate for the shard keys used by the shim. I'll put a small script in ops/tools. Snippet: `curl -XPOST https://ops/internal/kv/invalidate -d '{"shard":"shim-v2","pattern":"tenant:*"}'`

paul: On release notes — include migration guide and sample headers for mobile SDKs. Also call out the opt-out URL for support: https://support.redwood.com/rollout-optout

sophia: Good. Final checklist for tomorrow: pinlist uploaded by 00:30Z, post-pin smoke tests at 00:40Z, deploybot kickoff 01:00Z, canary monitor window 01:00-02:00Z. Rollback triggers: error spike (>0.5% over 5m), latency P95 > baseline+100ms, or client reports >20 tenants failing auth.

mike: Agree. I'll standby for manual rollback if automation fails.

release-ops: I'll own pinlist and release-notes publish. Uploading draft now to S3: s3://redwood-release-drafts/v2-tenant-shim/pinlist-draft.csv

deploybot: note: when shifting, deploybot will respect tenant pins and route pinned tenants to v1 until pin removed. Will log actions to #deploy-activity.

anya: One more: add a short TTLed banner in responses for canary traffic: `"x-redwood-rollout":"v2-canary"` so clients can surface telemetry.

sophia: Perfect — thanks all. If no objections, we'll proceed with the timeline. :thumbsup:

paul: No objections from me. I'll update release notes before 00:45Z.

mike: 0/5 readiness then. Standing by.

sophia: Closing thread — will post deploybot updates into #deploy-activity and ping here if anything unexpected shows up.
